name: Montevideo, Uruguay

visa.notes: Proof of stable income ~$1,500/mo required. Uruguay offers straightforward residency with path to citizenship.

rent.notes: Numbeo Montevideo (Nov 2026): 3BR centre 48,718 UYU (~1,215 USD), 3BR outside centre 38,258 UYU (~955 USD). InfoCasas Nov 2026 2BR apartments in Pocitos/Malvin/Punta Carretas 30,000-37,000 UYU plus gastos comunes 2,100-6,500 UYU (~900-1,100 USD all-in); Pocitos 2BR with garage 60,000+12,000 UYU (~1,800 USD). InfoCasas 2024 average 2BR Carrasco/Pocitos/Malvin 38,300 UYU. Pet-friendly 2-3BR with garage in a coastal barrio incl. GC.

groceries.notes: Montevideo Numbeo (Nov 2026, 73 contributors): single-person monthly costs excl. rent 969 USD; Expatistan May 2026 milk 54 UYU/l, eggs 231 UYU/dozen, chicken breast 246 UYU/500g. Food for two about 450-520 USD plus food for a 45 kg dog: cuantomecuesta mid-range dog food 4,500 UYU/mo x1.6 large-dog factor = ~7,200 UYU (about 180 USD), economy 4,800 UYU (~120 USD). CPI 4.68% y/y Sep 2026 so no basket shock. Montevideo has the widest supermarket choice (Disco, Devoto, Tienda Inglesa).

utilities.notes: UTE Residencial Simple from 30 Apr 2026: fixed 324.90 UYU, 83.20 UYU/kW, 6.74 UYU/kWh to 100 kWh, 8.45 to 600, plus 22% VAT; ~300 kWh is about 3,600 UYU (90 USD), ~500 kWh with electric heating in winter about 6,700 UYU (170 USD). OSE water/sewer tariffs rose Jan 2026 (roughly 1,000-1,300 UYU for a household); supergas cylinder for cooking/heating adds 10-25 USD. Trash is funded via owner-paid municipal tax. Numbeo Montevideo 85m2 utilities 188 USD, Expatistan 5,023 UYU (125 USD). Apartment with gastos comunes often covering hot water/heating partly; electricity dominates.

healthcare.notes: Resident retirees without BPS/FONASA affiliation pay a mutualista (IAMC) individual cuota directly: Asociacion Espanola 3,869 UYU/mo (Jul 2026), Medica Uruguaya ~3,200, CASMU ~3,400, i.e. about 90-97 USD per adult at ~40 UYU/USD, plus an emergencia movil plan (~272 UYU/adult). Typical = two mutualista cuotas plus emergencia movil; max = two adults in a private hospital plan such as Hospital Britanico (14,254-21,501 UYU per adult, joining age limit 60). Regulated copays (190-968 UYU per consult, 880 UYU ticket cap) are carried in medicalOOP. Max capped at 3x typical by the refresh QA pass (premium international plans can run higher).

petCare.notes: Large dog: annual vaccine package (sextuple + rabies) 2,100-2,600 UYU, quarterly flea/tick/worm treatment 1,500-2,200 UYU each (6,000-9,000/yr), 2 vet visits at 1,200-2,800 UYU; roughly 16,000-22,000 UYU/yr (about 400-550 USD), averaged with a margin for incidentals. Municipal (IMM) clinics are free for registered pets.

transportation.notes: Car optional. STM bus 52 UYU (1.30 USD) per 1-hour ticket, 78 UYU 2-hour; Numbeo monthly pass ~74 USD; jubilado discount fares (14-23 UYU) require BPS pension status, so not assumed for expat retirees. Car: nafta Super 90.45 UYU/l, terceros completo 1,385-1,550 UYU/month (BSE/Porto/Sura/Mapfre), plus patente and maintenance (~60-90 USD, patente estimated). Typical = one modest car used lightly plus some bus/taxi; min = transit only for two.

healthcare.system: FONASA public system; good private mutualistas (Hospital Británico, Médica Uruguaya). Quality comparable to developed nations.
healthcare.waitTimes: Moderate at public; short at private mutualistas
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Good coverage through mutualistas; pharmacies common
